name: Aeruginascin
summary: Aeruginascin, also known as 4-phosphoryloxy-N,N,N-trimethyltryptamine (4-PO-TMT), is a substituted tryptamine alkaloid which occurs naturally within the mushrooms Inocybe aeruginascens, Pholiotina cyanopus, and Psilocybe cubensis. It was discovered by Jochen Gartz.

pharmacology.text: Aeruginascin is the N-trimethyl analogue of psilocybin. It is closely related to the frog skin toxin bufotenidine (5-HTQ), a potent serotonin 5-HT3 receptor agonist, but the aeruginascin metabolite 4-HO-TMT (thought to be its active form) shows strong binding at the serotonin 5-HT2 receptors similar to psilocin. Unlike psilocybin, but similarly to 4-HO-TMT, aeruginascin does not produce the head-twitch response in rodents.

uses.text: The first report about the possible effects of aeruginascin is from a study published by Jochen Gartz in 1989. Across 23 analyzed cases of accidental hallucinogenic mushroom poisonings, people who had ingested the mushroom Inocybe aeruginascens reported only euphoric experiences.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is found in mushrooms alongside psilocybin, so effects reported after eating those mushrooms cannot be put down to it alone. Mushroom poisoning cases involving it described unusual experiences, but its own risks are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它與裸蓋菇素一同存在於蘑菇中，因此食用這些蘑菇後出現的反應，不能單獨歸因於它。涉及它的蘑菇中毒案例曾描述不尋常的經驗，但它本身的風險並不明確。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它与裸盖菇素一同存在于蘑菇中，因此食用这些蘑菇后出现的反应，不能单独归因于它。涉及它的蘑菇中毒案例曾描述不寻常的经验，但它本身的风险并不明确。

fact.en: Jochen Gartz discovered it in 1989 in the mushroom Inocybe aeruginascens. Its nitrogen carries three methyl groups and a fixed positive charge, which no other common mushroom tryptamine has.
fact.zh: Jochen Gartz於1989年在蘑菇Inocybe aeruginascens中發現了它。它的氮原子上接著三個甲基並帶有固定的正電荷，這是其他常見蘑菇色胺所沒有的。
fact.zhHans: Jochen Gartz于1989年在蘑菇Inocybe aeruginascens中发现了它。它的氮原子上接着三个甲基并带有固定的正电荷，这是其他常见蘑菇色胺所没有的。
